draft.subject: The documentation time comes back
draft.body:
Hyun-Woo,

Most behavioral health clinicians spend 90–120 minutes a day on notes, billing follow-up, and payer paperwork.

JotPsych gives that time back. Record on any device, structured notes instantly, and the platform scans every note and claim against 150+ payer rules before anything leaves your practice. Notes, e-prescribing, billing, and credentialing in one system.

Works with any EHR. Or replaces it entirely. Add JotPsych to the system you have today—no migration, up in 5 minutes. When you're ready, make it your whole practice.

10,000+ behavioral health practices. 2.5M+ notes written.

Worth another look?

Best,

Nathan Peereboom
CEO, JotPsych
